description: This file defines the class XMLFilter, a custom implementation of javax.swing.filechooser.FileFilter for filtering XML files with extension 'xml'. It provides methods for accepting files based on extension, managing the extension list, and generating descriptions of the filter.

classes.name: XMLFilter
classes.description: A file filter for XML files, allowing the acceptance of files with the 'xml' extension and directories for browsing purposes.

methods.name: XMLFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the 'xml' extension and a default description.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines whether a given file should be accepted by the filter based on its extension or if it is a directory.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension from a File object, or null if unavailable.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a new extension to the filter's list of accepted extensions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the filter, including the list of extensions if configured.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the textual description for this filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Configures whether the list of extensions is included in the description.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Returns whether the extension list is included in the description.
